services.name: Interaction_InitializePendingDisplayValue
services.behavior: Seeds the pending six-character display value during runtime initialization.

services.name: Interaction_SynchronizeResponseState
services.behavior: Compares the active display digits at 0x00FF7E29 with the pending six-byte value at 0x00FF7E30 and copies the pending bytes forward when the pending value has not passed the active value.

conclusion: The former anonymous reset helper is the initializer for the pending display buffer used by the interaction response synchronization path. The display's user-facing meaning remains unassigned.
